visualDirection: User reference compositions with full-color forest, cream paper, cocoa and olive panels, gold selection, bundled handwriting font.
verified: Prefab references, Chinese font coverage, unknown data and authoritative result display
Existing placement selection, cancellation, listener rebinding and fixture restart cleanup
Auxiliary pages pause the running fixture, block map raycasts, cancel placement and resume on close
Closing a page opened while already paused does not resume the level
Auxiliary pages cannot cover a result or loading transition
Unavailable levels cannot be launched by the selection button
Unity-rendered layout review: gameplay, placement, pause, results, bag, catalog, settings, subpages, main menu and level selection
limitations: PlayMode uses TEST_ONLY fixture counts, mechanisms and results; production level lifecycle and objective integration are not established by these tests.
Bag and save slots are presentation-only; there is no inventory or gameplay save data source.
Continue and unavailable levels are disabled, and no completion markers are fabricated.
Remove only explains that the feature is unavailable; no mechanism is destroyed.
Modal blur uses the existing forest illustration rather than a live scene capture.
Android touch input and device safe areas require device validation.
